newsitem.title: PERU: Peru president has minor oral surgery.
newsitem.headline: Peru president has minor oral surgery.

text.p: President Alberto Fujimori rested on Sunday evening after undergoing minor surgery to his mouth at Lima's top cancer hospital, Government Palace said in a statement.
The 58-year-old president spent nine hours in Lima's National Institute of Neoplastic Illnesses, which specialises in operations to treat or prevent cancer.
The statement said the operation was "satisfactory" but gave no further details.
Fujimori, who shows boundless energy in his frequent tours of the provinces and Lima shantytowns, has lost weight noticeably during his seven years in office.
